blocks.text: Luxury living in Cebu is taking on a more flexible shape, with spaces designed around the way people actually live. Whether it’s a few nights in the city, several weeks for work, time with family, or even bringing a pet along, people are increasingly looking for places that offer comfort and convenience without having to fit into a one-size-fits-all stay. That idea takes shape at Somerset Gorordo Cebu, which opened its doors for an exclusive media preview on September 18, 2026.
